rocm_bake_provenance.reduction_note: Bucket samples are quantiles of the originals, not the raw measurements: the oracle draws with random.choice(), so a uniform draw over evenly spaced quantiles samples the same empirical distribution. num_samples still records how many measurements each bucket rests on. Keep quantile_points at or above VLLM_EMULATOR_ORACLE_MIN_SAMPLES (default 30) or adaptive-K pooling will start merging neighbouring buckets that it previously did not.
rocm_bake_provenance.warning: Only the device IDENTITY was relabelled. Every latency in this pack was measured on NVIDIA A40 and is a placeholder until a capture on gfx1250 replaces it. Do not read these timings as gfx1250 performance.
